title: Add S3 three-register rank lower bound
body:
## Summary

Adds a scoped representation-rank lower bound for one three-register target in
the finite nonabelian address algebra `F2[S3]`.

For paid labels `s=(12)` and `t=(23)`, rank-one idempotents
`N in M_3(F2)`, and target `diag([s],[t],[st])`, the two-dimensional faithful
representation of `S3` sends each paid update to a rank-one perturbation. The
represented target differs from identity by rank four, so telescoping gives a
uniform lower bound of four calls. The direct four-call witness attains it.

## Evidence

- `python3.12 -I -B research/bit-s3-three-register-rank-target-seed57b2/verify.py`
  → `PASS_S3_THREE_REGISTER_RANK_BOUND q_lower=4 direct=4 target_rank=4 paid_delta_rank=1 idempotents=28 omissions=4`
- `python3.12 -O -I -B .../verify.py` returns the same PASS line.
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-s3-three-register-rank-target-seed57b2`
  → `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

The verifier checks the S3 representation and multiplication table, all 28
rank-one scalar idempotents, the exact witness in the full group algebra, and
four deletion controls.

## Scope and limits

The result is for one exact target and a one-unit paid-call model. It makes no
claim about native source generation, hosting, precision, transfer to the
selected rational-frame supplier, a new `kappa`, or the multiplication
theorem. The assigned selected-result binding check was attempted but could
not finish because the sparse worktree omits other selected package roots;
the exact status is recorded in `TASK.json` and the session result.

The endpoint differs from the exact mixed S3 triples in Discussion #2012 and
the two-register S3 census. `OVERLAP.md` records cached and refreshed live
overlap checks. No predecessor code is imported. Substantial OpenAI Codex
assistance is disclosed; no independent human or formal review is claimed.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-s3-three-register-rank-target-seed57b2` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-s3-three-register-rank-target-seed57b2 --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
